name: Functional Lipschitz Injection
description: Replaces 1D geometric intervals and non-overlap constraints with their function-space dual: non-decreasing Lipschitz continuous cumulative allocations. The "no overlap" condition becomes a bound on the sum of function increments, and the "left of" condition becomes a split point $c_k$ in the domain. This preserves the exact algebraic bounds while stripping all geometric keywords that trigger pattern matching.
